title: o-mcp/dashboard v1
description: A saved dashboard's document (frontend.dashboard.document, format_version 1): its time range, refresh, channels, and each widget's place and own settings (design/frontend.md §3-§5, §8). Written by web/, checked by the API on every save. The shell reads everything but `settings`, which belongs to the widget type and is never read by anything else. Version 1 may gain optional fields; a reader ignores fields it doesn't know. Removing or renaming a field, or changing what one means, makes version 2, and web/ migrates older documents when it reads them.

time.description: The dashboard's one time range (decision 1), in the tenant's time zone, half-open. Relative ends follow Grafana: `now`, `now-30m`, `now-24h`, `now-7d`; `/d`, `/w`, `/M` or `/y` rounds to the start of that unit, or as `to` its end, so `now/d` to `now/d` is today. Absolute ends are site dates or minutes.

refresh.description: Seconds between refreshes, or null for off, the default (decision 2). The API answers faster polls from its 30 s cache.

channels.description: The entity each channel holds (§5): widgets on a channel show it and follow when it changes. Channels A to D; an empty channel is left out.

type.description: The widget registry's key. An unknown type is drawn as a placeholder, never dropped.

title.description: Shown in the header; null for the type's default.

x.description: Column, of 24 (§4), as a Grafana panel's gridPos.

w.description: Width in columns. The registry's minimum applies when drawn, not when saved.

channel.description: The channel the widget follows, or null for its own settings only.

settings.description: The widget type's own settings. Nodes are graph.node ids (decision 19).

entity.description: What a channel carries: its kind as well as its id, so a node widget ignores a device (§5).

id.description: graph.node.id, public.devices.id, or a graph category code.
